translations.web: This wisdom is not that which comes down from above, but is earthly, sensual, and demonic.
translations.bsb: Such wisdom does not come from above, but is earthly, unspiritual, demonic.
translations.kjv: This wisdom descendeth not from above, but is earthly, sensual, devilish.
